name: CountActiveMultiplayerParticipantSlots
evidence: Counts active multiplayer slots used as the human-controlled prefix in modes 6 and 7.

name: LookupGateAttributeBonus
evidence: Pure six-value Gate-card and attribute-indexed lookup with no activation-state mutation.

name: BeginAbilityEffectActivation
evidence: Copies selected Ability metadata into the effect scene and dispatches shared execution.

name: ConsumeActivatedAbilitySlot
evidence: Resolves the active participant and selected slot then requests state 2 through the shared setter.

name: CompleteAbilityEffectResolution
evidence: Returns completion after state-19 cleanup advances the effect scene to terminal state 20.

name: ConstructAIController
evidence: Initializes the participant-owned AI decision object stored at participant +0xC8.

name: ConstructBattleObject
evidence: Derives Gate owner and constructs the two 20-byte combatant records.

name: ConstructBattleResultController
evidence: Initializes signed winner index +0x21 to -1 and stores the linked battle object at +0x38.

name: AdvanceBattleResultState
evidence: Resolves and consumes winner and loser combatant indices through result finalization.

name: FinalizeNormalGateResult
evidence: Maps the settled winner to a participant and increments participant match score +0xEE before capture-history bookkeeping.

name: AppendParticipantCaptureHistory
evidence: Appends one six-byte losing-combatant record at participant +0x84 and increments capture-history count +0xF4.

name: CalculateBattleWinnerIndex
evidence: Evaluates the two combatant records and returns winner record index 0 or 1.

name: SelectCombatantAbilitySlot
evidence: Calls the participant Ability selector during battle preparation and receives slot 0 to 2 or 0xFF.

name: ConsumeSelectedAbilitySlot
evidence: Consumes the accepted prepared slot by requesting participant Ability state 2.

name: ConstructGateSessionState
evidence: Clears arena-placement board-grid placement-count and descriptor state for a new Gate session.

name: AllocateArenaPlacement
evidence: Creates an occupied arena entry assigns owner Gate-slot state 1 and increments session +0x294.

name: RemoveArenaPlacement
evidence: Clears arena occupied and board-grid state writes owner Gate-slot state 2 and decrements session +0x294.

name: TransferActiveArenaPlacement
evidence: Returns the old owner slot to 0 replaces arena owner and slot identity and assigns the replacement slot state 1.

name: AttachCombatantDescriptor
evidence: Links a descriptor to an arena entry and increments the separate session +0x295 descriptor count.

name: DetachCombatantDescriptor
evidence: Clears descriptor linkage and decrements the separate session +0x295 descriptor count.

name: SetCombatantDescriptorPair
evidence: Stores defender descriptor at session +0x28D and challenger descriptor at +0x28E.

name: SeedScriptedMatchScores
evidence: One of four byte-identical setup blocks that increments both primary participant +0xEE scores twice.

name: CheckGateMatchVictory
evidence: Tests each participant score or team aggregate against the unsigned victory threshold of three.

name: ConstructParticipant
evidence: Initializes the 320-byte participant object and clears Gate-slot score capture-history and availability state.

name: InitializeParticipantControlIdentity
evidence: Leaves participant +0xC8 null for human slots and allocates an AI controller for later slots.

name: DestroyParticipantMembers
evidence: Destroys the optional AI controller without performing an authoritative in-place Gate-state reset.

name: DeleteParticipant
evidence: Cleans participant members and frees the participant object without an in-place score or Gate-state reset.

name: SetParticipantGateSlotState
evidence: Maintains Gate-slot states 0 1 and 2 and adjusts +0xF8 only across the zero/nonzero boundary.

name: SetParticipantAbilitySlotState
evidence: Maintains the three Ability slot-state bytes and available count +0xF9 across zero/nonzero transitions.

name: ApplyScriptedGateSlotSetup
evidence: Scripted setup can preassign unavailable state 2 and directly force participant +0xF8 to zero.

name: ChooseSelectableGateSlot
evidence: Counts and chooses only participant Gate slots whose lifecycle state is zero.

name: SelectAvailableAbilitySlot
evidence: Chooses among state-zero Ability slots or returns 0xFF when none are available.

name: BranchOnActiveParticipantAI
evidence: Selects AI-specific battle setup when active participant +0xC8 is non-null.

name: RunAIShotPlanner
evidence: Returns for null +0xC8 and consumes the AI controller when non-null.
